Zoe H: Heads up — fantasy soccer semis are this Wed. Lineups lock 90m before kickoff. Who's coming to the kitchen for a live stream + snacks? :soccer:
Carlos P: In. Also down for a $3 side pot for 'most points from substitutes' — makes benching decisions spicy. :money_with_wings:
Mei L: Ooh spicy. I'm in for $3. Can we add a small MVP pick? Tie-breaker could be total goals in the match.
Arjun S: Quick rules: no trades after Tue 11:59pm (final deadline). Also free agent pickup window closes 30m before kickoff.
Ben T: I'll set up the stream in the kitchen TV and bring a wireless speaker. Anyone want to claim snack duty? I can do chips + dip if someone else does something healthy. :chipmunk:
Zoe H: I'll do fruit + granola bars. Also can we make a tiny coin for the MVP guess? Winner gets the pot + bragging rights.
Carlos P: MVP = any player in the fixture, not season MVP, right?
Mei L: Yes, single-match MVP. I'll vote banana bread as an acceptable snack. :banana:
Arjun S: Code snippet for people who forget how to set lineup on our provider: ```/setlineup team123 GK:Alvarez DF:Nguyen MF:Silva FW:Khan``` Save it 2x to be safe.
OpsBot: Reminder posted: Lineups lock 90m before kickoff (Wed 18:30 UTC). Poll created for watch location (Kitchen vs Virtual). Vote: https://tinyurl.com/office-footy-watch
CalendarBot: Event created: Office Watch Party — Wed 18:00 @Kitchen TV. Invite sent to channel attendees.
Ben T: Kitchen has HDMI + spare dongles. If you need to join remotely, I'll DM a stream link.
Mei L: One more rule: if your starter gets injured before kickoff and replaced by bench, bench points count as normal. No refunds for bad calls.
Zoe H: Agreed. Also for the $ pot collection, @Carlos can you Venmo me after the game? I'll hold funds and hand over winner pizza voucher.
Carlos P: Yep. I'll Venmo $3 to @ZoeH after the match.
Arjun S: Friendly reminder: no trash-talking the office champion too hard until lunch. They cry easily. :sweat_smile:
Ben T: :raised_hands: RSVP'ed on the calendar. Bringing HDMI + cables and a backup pizza coupon. Good luck everyone!
OpsBot: Poll closed — majority chose Kitchen watch. Pinning the event and the rules doc in #random.
Zoe H: Awesome. Kitchen at 18:00, kickoff 19:00, lineups lock 90m before kickoff (so midnight? jk). See you there and may your captain picks be merciful. :trophy:
